# EnglishOnline.training — Free English Exercises

> Free, interactive English exercises for German secondary school students (Gymnasium and Oberschule, Years 7–10), MSA and Abitur exam practice for Berlin/Brandenburg, and English for business, IT and university learners. Every exercise marks itself, gives instant feedback and a German school grade (Note 1–5). No sign-up or login.

Written and taught by Shaun Trezise, a TEFL-certified English teacher in Berlin. The exercises are aligned to the German school curriculum and used in real classrooms. Each exercise page walks through several steps (reading or listening, vocabulary, grammar, writing) and scores the answers in the browser.

Gymnasium exercises are entirely in English. The German grammar topic pages and the MSA hub are aimed at German search traffic and are written in German.

Main site with articles, guides and Business English training: https://englishonline.training/llms.txt

## School exercises by year group

- [Year 7 Gymnasium](https://activities.englishonline.training/7g-activities.html): Grammar, reading and vocabulary practice.
- [Year 7 Oberschule](https://activities.englishonline.training/7c-activities.html): Reading, writing and comprehension practice.
- [Year 8 Gymnasium](https://activities.englishonline.training/8g-activities.html): Exercises on the USA, roughly B1 level.
- [Year 8 Oberschule](https://activities.englishonline.training/8c-activities.html): Exercises on the regions of the USA, roughly A2 level.
- [Year 9 Gymnasium](https://activities.englishonline.training/9g-activities.html): California, Australia, Canada, Ireland, India and New Zealand.
- [Year 9 Oberschule](https://activities.englishonline.training/9c-activities.html): South Africa, Australia, Canada and everyday topics, with revision.
- [Year 10 Gymnasium](https://activities.englishonline.training/10g-activities.html): Scotland, Black America and youth culture, roughly B2/C1 level.
- [Year 10 Oberschule](https://activities.englishonline.training/10c-activities.html): Commonwealth countries, grammar and civil rights.

## Exam preparation

- [Abitur English](https://activities.englishonline.training/abitur-activities.html): Practice packs for the Berlin/Brandenburg English Abitur: text analysis, mediation, argumentative writing and summaries.
- [MSA Englisch](https://activities.englishonline.training/msa-activities.html): Full MSA practice units with listening, reading and writing, graded on the official MSA table (German).

## Grammar

- [ESL Grammar Exercises](https://activities.englishonline.training/esl-grammar-activities.html): The topics learners struggle with most: articles, prepositions, tenses, conditionals.
- [Grammatik-Übungen](https://activities.englishonline.training/grammar-activities.html): One interactive exercise per grammar topic (German instructions).
- [Englische Grammatik nach Thema](https://activities.englishonline.training/themen/): Short explanations of passive, if-clauses, relative clauses, tenses and more, each linked to exercises (German).
- [Grammar quizzes](https://activities.englishonline.training/quiz-grammar-easy.html): Four self-scoring quizzes from easy to hardest.

## Business, IT and university English

- [Business English](https://activities.englishonline.training/business-activities.html): Company case studies, meetings, negotiations, presentations and emails.
- [IT English](https://activities.englishonline.training/it-activities.html): For vocational IT trainees: networking, cybersecurity, AI, support and workplace safety, B1–B2.
- [University English](https://activities.englishonline.training/uni-activities.html): Academic and professional skills: relationships, case studies, project management, data and hedging language.

## Tools and free resources

- [English Level Test](https://activities.englishonline.training/level-test.html): Adaptive placement test with a CEFR result (A1–C1) and matching exercises.
- [Vocabulary Games](https://activities.englishonline.training/vocab-games.html): Matching, gap-fill, multiple-choice and word-scramble games.
- [IELTS Vocabulary Glossary](https://activities.englishonline.training/ielts-vocabulary-glossary.html): Searchable IELTS vocabulary with definitions and a matching game.
- [Business Email Phrase Bank](https://activities.englishonline.training/lead-business-email-phrasebank.html): 40 professional email phrases sorted by situation.
- [Redemittel für die Textanalyse](https://activities.englishonline.training/lead-abitur-textanalyse.html): Ten phrases for Abitur text analysis, with practice tasks (German).
- [MSA Prüfungs-Checkliste](https://activities.englishonline.training/lead-msa-checkliste.html): Checklist for the written MSA English exam (German).
- [3 auto-graded tasks for teachers](https://activities.englishonline.training/lead-teachers-three-tasks.html): Ready-to-use tasks a teacher can set a class with no student sign-up.

## Optional

- [All exercises, filterable](https://activities.englishonline.training/activities.html): The full list of every exercise, filterable by level, skill and topic.
- [My Progress](https://activities.englishonline.training/dashboard.html): Progress, streaks and scores, stored in the visitor's own browser.
- [Sitemap](https://activities.englishonline.training/sitemap.xml): Every public page.
